clue.text: Phone yard for benzene, perhaps

blocks.note: to ring someone is to phone them
a yard or enclosure is a compound

explanation.surface: Someone telephones a yard to ask after a supply of benzene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Phone' looks like a noun, but it is the verb, to ring.
explanation.definitionFit: Benzene is the textbook example of a chemical whose molecules form a closed ring of carbon atoms.

clue.text: Synthesizer user, so piano third’s out

indicators.note: out can mean disordered or wrong, so the letters before it come out of their order

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A keyboard player swaps to a synthesizer, so the piano's third part is dropped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' looks like it removes the third letter of piano, but it scrambles all three words.
explanation.definitionFit: A radiophonist makes electronic sound for radio, typically with synthesizers and other sound generators.

clue.text: Cambodia protected by approach of old goddess

indicators.note: something protected by another is surrounded and shielded by it

blocks.note: an obsolete spelling of nigh, to approach
K is the international vehicle code for Cambodia

explanation.surface: Cambodian temples guarding the way in to an ancient goddess's shrine.
explanation.definitionFit: Nike was the winged Greek goddess of victory, worshipped in antiquity.

clue.text: Mostly bring in revolutionary new coins

Che Guevara, the archetypal revolutionary
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.walkthrough: 'bring in' looks like an insertion signal but is the verb gross, to earn before deductions.
explanation.definitionFit: A groschen was a small coin of Austria and the German states; the word is both singular and plural.

clue.text: Seeing as Persians upset the old in Diplomatic Corps

indicators.note: in places the preceding letters inside the following abbreviation

blocks.note: CD is the abbreviation for Corps Diplomatique
past tense of eat, to upset or worry, as in what's eating you
ye is an archaic form of the

explanation.walkthrough: Persians are cats, not people from Iran; cats famously see in dim light.
explanation.definitionFit: Cat-eyed means able to see in the dark, as a cat such as a Persian can.

clue.text: Make fun of bustle material

ado is fuss or bustle

explanation.surface: Someone ridicules the padded bustle of a Victorian dress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bustle' suggests the dress pad, but it means commotion.
explanation.definitionFit: Mockado was a woollen pile fabric, an imitation velvet, used for clothing in the 16th and 17th centuries.

clue.text: Rowing boat for one

blocks.note: pro is Latin for for, as in pros and cons
a means one

explanation.walkthrough: 'for one' reads like a single sculler, but each word is a piece.

clue.text: Style of graphic novel you like lecturer’s dismissed

blocks.note: taken as written
L is the abbreviation for lecturer

explanation.walkthrough: 'graphic novel' looks like one phrase, but graphic ends the definition and novel signals the shuffle.

clue.text: Working in advance reversed failure

on means forward, onward

clue.text: Party noticed crawling cockroach?

blocks.note: taken as written

clue.text: Prince investing millions in carriage

blocks.note: AK is the US postal abbreviation for Alaska
a girl's name

clue.text: Information about return of fine RAF DC-3

blocks.note: data is information
OK means fine

clue.text: Tree I found in cave once

taken as written

clue.text: Galvanise more than half of Spanish gypsies

clue.text: What can be animal or vegetable? Okay, true in a way

definitions.text: What can be animal or vegetable?

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A twenty-questions answer: animal or vegetable? Okay, true in a way.

clue.text: What’s quickly put back in the ear

blocks.note: cito is Latin for quickly, familiar from prescriptions

clue.text: Man in rather white dated musical

blocks.note: paly is an old word for somewhat pale
Joe is a generic man

clue.text: Wine lover’s about before feast

clue.text: Beethoven’s third about welcoming French ruler?

definitions.text: Beethoven’s third about welcoming French ruler?

blocks.note: the third letter of the name

roi is French for king

clue.text: One article included in stuff, some of mine

blocks.note: to pad is to stuff
Roman numeral one
the definite article

clue.text: Help to limit parrot-fish parasite

blocks.note: aid is help
scar, or scarus, is a parrot-fish

clue.text: Hard as soldiers on Troy camp

ut is Latin for as
men are ordinary soldiers
joins the soldiers to what follows; supplies no letters
T is the abbreviation for troy weight

clue.text: Note short fibres combed out all over young cat

blocks.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale
noil is the short fibre combed out of wool before spinning

explanation.walkthrough: 'combed out' looks like an anagram signal, but it belongs to the definition of noil.

clue.text: Turns opposite tree

blocks.note: milk that turns sours
op is short for opposite

explanation.surface: Someone turns to face a tree.

clue.text: Tons perishing in Turin, caught by side of Po River

C for caught in cricket scoring
the last letter of the river's name

blocks.note: taken as written

the first letter

zo, or dzo, is a Himalayan yak-cattle cross

L for left
